# Generated by tools/gen_metal_industry.py - edit that, not this.

# Imports of all resources tie up more than 40% of our civilian factories.
# A civilian factory buys 8 units of any resource (vanilla cic = 0.125).
wif_metal_trade_burden_high = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_imp_cost = resource_imported@oil }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_imp_cost = resource_imported@aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_imp_cost = resource_imported@rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_imp_cost = resource_imported@tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_imp_cost = resource_imported@steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_imp_cost = resource_imported@chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_imp_cost = resource_imported@coal }
	divide_temp_variable = { wif_imp_cost = 8 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_imp_limit = num_of_civilian_factories }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_imp_limit = 0.4 }
	check_variable = { wif_imp_cost > wif_imp_limit }
}

# The AI should build a steel plant: short even after trading, or
# importing it while imports already cost too much.
wif_ai_wants_wif_steel_manufacturer = {
	has_tech = wif_metal_working_plants
	OR = {
		has_resources_in_country = { resource = steel amount < 0 }
		AND = {
			has_resources_in_country = { resource = steel amount > 0 only_imported = yes }
			wif_metal_trade_burden_high = yes
		}
	}
}
